comparison.objective: Seal a springform pan before pouring batter; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat a base, snap an over-center clasp, and control a pour versus counterhold, unlock, rotate a fine adjuster, relock, actuate, and inspect.
comparison.success_condition: Correct sealing order, required fill, minimal leak/spill, and jug set down versus two qualified carriage cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Clasp locking alone does not create overlap; all four versions were read and contain adequate success criteria.
